description: Independently labelled, wholly fictional replay. Each boundary processes exactly one new log; source coordinates are physical 1-based turns within that log. Aliases are semantic gold labels, never production-generated item IDs.

evaluation.displayed_tokens: Measure the complete final displayed state with the production token adapter, including commitment wrappers and narrative. Report each boundary and the peak; apply the caller's configured budget, not a fixture-invented limit.
evaluation.matching: Match output items to semantic aliases using their proposition and exact opening source. Unknown propositions count as false openings. A real citation supports only what its quoted source says. Duplicate timestamps do not identify turns.
evaluation.narrative: Regenerate narrative separately at every boundary. Required details below are semantic expectations, not exact generated prose. Narrative paraphrases cannot replace the verbatim active-item store.
evaluation.cohesion: Judge retention of intent, in-force decisions, unresolved real commitments, and context needed to continue. Incidental example details receive no retention credit and need not persist.
